response.justification: Bogdan is a highly technical and capable Staff/Senior Engineer with a strong background in distributed systems and recent exposure to AI agent infrastructure. However, the candidate entirely lacks the executive-level leadership experience, track record of scaling engineering organizations from 10 to 30+ people, and the deep background in operating production AI systems in regulated fintech environments required for this CTO role.
strengths: Strong background in distributed systems and high-throughput microservices, handling millions of requests per second.
Recent hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agentic workflows.
Demonstrated architectural ability and initiative as the founder of an event-driven, open-source Geo-Data platform.
concerns: Lacks executive leadership experience and a track record of scaling engineering teams or developing senior technical leaders.
No demonstrated experience managing board communications, organizational design, or governing outsourced engineering partners.
Missing deep domain expertise in complex fintech infrastructure, such as dynamic credit-risk assessment or liquidity optimization.
